parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; <short pause> I will make him an help meet for him. <short pause> Genesis, chapter two, verse eighteen.
Lord God, thank You for seeing our need for companionship and care. <short pause> Bless the people You have placed beside me, and help me to love them as You love me. <short pause> Amen.
